**Art Director Final QA — 5 Lower Homepage Screenshots** --- ### **Screenshot 1: Oracle Stages / Architecture (L6–L1)** | Check | Verdict | |-------|---------| | **1) AI-template vs. private‑bank editorial?** | ✅ **Private‑bank editorial.** Clean two‑column ledger, serif/sans hierarchy, ample whitespace, and the “ARCHITECTURE” vertical tab feel like a high‑end institutional report, not a generic SaaS template. | | **2) Remaining Lucide line‑icons in static layout?** | ❌ **Yes – 2 offenders.**
• The **speaker/volume icon** inside the circular button next to “GitHub”.
• The **up‑arrow icon** inside the brown scroll‑to‑top button (bottom‑right).
Both are thin stroke icons that clash with the otherwise icon‑free, type‑driven layout. | | **3) Visible em‑dash ‘—’?** | ✅ **Present and correct.** Used as a subtle separator in the sub‑labels (e.g. *“Yield strategies · templates · NFTs”* and *“E2E encrypted · Merkle‑anchored hourly”*). Consistent with the brand’s punctuation style. | | **4) Layout bugs (overflow / misalignment / overlapping fixed)?** | ⚠️ **Minor alignment note.**
• The right‑side vertical dot navigation (“ARCHITECTURE”) sits very close to the viewport edge; on narrower viewports it may clip or overlap the scrollbar.
• Otherwise clean: no text overflow, no z‑index collisions, grid lines align perfectly. | **Score: 8/10** **Last fix:** Replace the Lucide speaker and up‑arrow with either (a) custom SVG marks that match the wordmark’s weight, or (b) pure text labels (“Sound” / “Top”) to keep the editorial feel intact. --- ### **Screenshot 2: Features / VaultChat Zone** | Check | Verdict | |-------|---------| | **1) AI-template vs. private‑bank editorial?** | ✅ **Private‑bank editorial.** The “BEYOND LENDING” label, large serif headline with gold accent, and the chat UI mockup read like a luxury fintech whitepaper spread. | | **2) Remaining Lucide line‑icons in static layout?** | ❌ **Same 2 repeat offenders.**
• Speaker icon (header).
• Up‑arrow icon (scroll‑to‑top).
No other icons detected in this section. | | **3) Visible em‑dash ‘—’?** | ✅ **Used correctly.** Appears in *“CONVERSATION — ENCRYPTED”* and feature taglines (*“E2E encrypted · Merkle‑anchored hourly”*). | | **4) Layout bugs?** | ✅ **Clean.** Two‑column feature grid (VaultChat / PrivacyMixer / ComplianceModule etc.) is well‑balanced. Chat bubble mockup is properly contained within its card border. No overflow or fixed‑element overlap. | **Score: 9/10** **Last fix:** Swap the two persistent header/footer Lucide icons (see Screen 1 note). Everything else is production‑ready. --- ### **Screenshot 3: Hero / Brand Lockup** | Check | Verdict | |-------|---------| | **1) AI-template vs. private‑bank editorial?** | ✅ **Strong private‑bank editorial.** Minimalist hero with concentric circle motif, elegant mixed‑case “XELIS Vault” lockup, and micro‑copy (“V11.5 · AUDIT‑REMEDIATED”) screams institutional confidence. | | **2) Remaining Lucide line‑icons?** | ❌ **Still the same 2.** Speaker + up‑arrow. No other icons here. | | **3) Visible em‑dash ‘—’?** | ✅ **Yes.** *“V11.5 · AUDIT‑REMEDIATED (18/18)”* uses middle dots; em‑dashes appear elsewhere on the page, so this is acceptable variation. | | **4) Layout bugs?** | ✅ **Flawless.** Perfect centering of the app icon, headline, and tagline. Vertical dot nav is positioned correctly without overlap. | **Score: 9.5/10** **Last fix:** Only the recurring Lucide icon swap. This screen is the strongest visually. --- ### **Screenshot 4: xUSD Stablecoin Zone** | Check | Verdict | |-------|---------| | **1) AI-template vs. private‑bank editorial?** | ✅ **Private‑bank editorial.** “THE STABLECOIN” overline, large teal “xUSD” wordmark, and the professional handshake photo with italic caption (*“One dollar in, one dollar out.”*) feel like a private‑bank product sheet. | | **2) Remaining Lucide line‑icons?** | ❌ **Same 2 again.** Speaker + up‑arrow. | | **3) Visible em‑dash ‘—’?** | ✅ **Correct.** Used in *“USD‑pegged · Encrypted · Overcollateralized”* and photo caption. | | **4) Layout bugs?** | ⚠️ **One minor issue.**
• The **“SavingsRate”** card at the bottom appears partially cut off / fading into the background (likely intentional reveal‑on‑scroll, but in this static screenshot it looks like a render truncation).
• Otherwise, text wraps cleanly around the image card; no overflow. | **Score: 8.5/10** **Last fix:** (a) Replace Lucide icons. (b) Confirm that the SavingsRate section is meant to be a fade‑in teaser; if not, adjust padding/margin so it renders fully. --- ### **Screenshot 5: VLT Token Zone** | Check | Verdict | |-------|---------| | **1) AI-template vs. private‑bank editorial?** | ✅ **Private‑bank editorial.** Gold bars imagery, deflationary narrative (“engineered to shrink”), and structured data blocks (Token Distribution / Deflationary Curve) read like a wealth‑management token report. | | **2) Remaining Lucide line‑icons?** | ❌ **Same 2.** Speaker + up‑arrow. Additionally, the **small colored dots** next to “Oracle Rewards” and “Chat Relayer Rewards” are decorative, not Lucide, so they pass. | | **3) Visible em‑dash ‘—’?** | ✅ **Present.** *“Total Supply · 10,000,000 VLT · Fixed”* uses middle dots; em‑dashes are used consistently elsewhere on the page. | | **4) Layout bugs?** | ⚠️ **One alignment nit.**
• The top metric bar (*“Target Peg / Collateral Ratio / PSM Fee”*) is slightly misaligned with the main content grid below—it floats higher than the “THE GOVERNANCE TOKEN” label’s baseline. Consider snapping it to the same left margin or adding a subtle separator. | **Score: 8/10** **Last fix:** (a) Icon swap. (b) Vertically align the top stats row with the section header or add a hairline rule to anchor it visually. --- ## **Overall Summary** | Metric | Result | |--------|--------| | **Aesthetic Direction** | ✅ **Private‑bank editorial** across all 5 screens. No AI‑template residue. Typography, color (black/gold/teal), and photography choices are cohesive and premium. | | **Icon Hygiene** | ❌ **2 persistent Lucide line‑icons** (speaker, up‑arrow) break the editorial illusion on every screen. They must be replaced with custom marks or removed. | | **Typography/Punctuation** | ✅ Em‑dashes and middle dots are used correctly and consistently. | | **Layout Integrity** | ✅ **No critical bugs** (no overflow, no overlapping fixed elements). Only minor alignment polish needed on the VLT stats bar and a check on the xUSD SavingsRate truncation. | | **Overall Score** | **8.6 / 10** | ### **Final Go‑Live Checklist** - [ ] **Replace** the header speaker icon and footer up‑arrow icon with brand‑consistent SVGs (or text). - [ ] **Align** the VLT top metrics row to the “THE GOVERNANCE TOKEN” baseline. - [ ] **Verify** that the xUSD SavingsRate card is intentionally a scroll‑reveal placeholder; if not, expose it fully. - [ ] **Test** the right‑side “ARCHITECTURE” dot nav on 1280px and 1440px widths to ensure it never touches the scrollbar. Once those 4 items are cleared, the lower homepage is **art‑ready for launch**.
